تستفردون (form X)
# تَسْتَفْرِدُونَ (tastafridūna) /tas.taf.ri.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفْرَدَ (istafrada)
# تُسْتَفْرَدُونَ (tustafradūna) /tus.taf.ra.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَفْرَدَ (istafrada)
